Container.Name: VynodeArr
Container.Overview: Unified, self-hosted movie and television library management for Unraid. VynodeArr includes installation-managed Radarr and Sonarr engines behind one secure dashboard while keeping each engine's database and settings isolated. Manage libraries, requests, automatic and interactive searches, queues, history, wanted media, calendars, collections, discovery, trailers, poster overlays, backups, and service configuration. Radarr and Sonarr remain GPLv3 projects maintained by their respective contributors. VynodeArr is licensed under Apache 2.0.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the VynodeArr web interface and compatibility APIs.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent VynodeArr accounts, settings, backups, and isolated engine databases. Back up this folder before removal.

Config.Name: Main media folder (optional)
Config.Description: Recommended for multiple libraries beneath one parent share. Example host path: /mnt/user/media. VynodeArr scans only direct child folders such as /media/movies, /media/movies-4k, /media/tv, or /media/anime-tv and lets you assign each one to Movies or Television under Service Settings. Leave blank to use only the legacy /movies and /tv mappings.

Config.Name: Legacy movie library (optional)
Config.Description: Backward-compatible movie mapping for existing installations or a simple single-library setup. Leave blank when /media exposes this library as a child folder.

Config.Name: Legacy television library (optional)
Config.Description: Backward-compatible television mapping for existing installations or a simple single-library setup. Leave blank when /media exposes this library as a child folder.

Config.Name: Completed downloads
Config.Description: Completed-download share accessible to VynodeArr and your download client. Keep this container path as /downloads.

Config.Name: Download client remote path
Config.Description: Container path reported by the download client for completed files, for example /data/complete. VynodeArr maps it to /downloads.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for schedules and displayed dates, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: TMDB read token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for Discover during first start. It can be added or replaced later under Service Settings.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when every browser connection reaches VynodeArr through HTTPS.
